clue.text: English on staff love equestrian event

indicators.note: in an across answer 'on' places the letter for English after the staff

parts.note: a staff is a rod or stick
love is zero in tennis, which looks like the letter O

explanation.surface: A list of the things an English rider might love: carrying a staff at a horse show.
explanation.definitionFit: A rodeo is a show where cowboys compete at riding broncos and roping cattle, so it is a contest on horseback.

clue.text: Beast caught between money and love

indicators.note: between tells us the catch letter sits inside, flanked by the word for money and the word for love

parts.note: rhino is old British slang for money
Eros is the Greek god of love
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A creature trapped in a tug of war between greed and affection.
explanation.walkthrough: RHINO meaning cash is dated British slang, so 'money' hides one half of the beast's own name.
explanation.definitionFit: The rhinoceros is a large horned African or Asian animal, so it is a beast in the plainest sense.

clue.text: Sauce that should get us into gear

definitions.meaning: a salad sauce such as vinaigrette is called this

definitions.text: that should get us into gear
definitions.meaning: putting on clothes, or gear, is what this activity does for us

explanation.surface: A sauce that will pep us up and get things moving.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Get into gear' sounds like starting an engine or getting going, but gear here means clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: A dressing is a sauce poured over salad, and dressing is also the act of putting on clothes.

clue.text: Van Gogh used this anguish amid furious toil

indicators.note: amid tells us the word for anguish is set in the middle of the rearranged letters
furious suggests wild disorder, so the letters of toil are thrown into a new order

parts.note: anguish is suffering or pain

explanation.surface: Van Gogh, tormented, labouring frantically at his canvases.
explanation.walkthrough: 'furious' turns toil into OILT, and 'amid' sets the word for anguish inside it after the L; the surface pain is Van Gogh's own.
explanation.definitionFit: Van Gogh painted in oils, so the medium he used is a fitting description of his material.

clue.text: Drollery less desirable as one gets on!

parts.note: something bad is less desirable than it might be
getting on means growing old, so as one gets on is 'in age'

explanation.surface: A wry remark that humour sours with the years.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as a phrase, the clue says something gets worse with age; split differently it is BAD followed by IN AGE.
explanation.definitionFit: Badinage is light, playful banter, and drollery is likewise dry, amusing talk.

clue.text: Vampire's one beginning to excite rage

parts.note: a vampire is one kind of bat

indicators.note: beginning to asks for only the opening letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A vampire's mere first stirrings are enough to provoke fury.
explanation.walkthrough: BATE is an old British word for a fit of temper.
explanation.definitionFit: In British usage a bate is a temper tantrum, a fit of rage.

clue.text: Popular achievement for sure

parts.note: something popular is in, or fashionable
a deed is an achievement or exploit

explanation.surface: A popular achievement, beyond any doubt.
explanation.definitionFit: Indeed is an adverb of emphasis meaning certainly or truly.

clue.text: Fuss at home about judge becoming neighbour

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for fuss wraps round the letter for judge

parts.note: ado is fuss or bother
being in means being at home

explanation.surface: A neighbour causes a stir at home over a judge moving in next door.
explanation.walkthrough: Neighbour is used as a verb here, meaning to lie next to.
explanation.definitionFit: To neighbour something is to be next to it, which is what joining on alongside means.

clue.text: Peter Sellers holds tongue

indicators.note: holds says the words contain the answer inside them, spanning the actor's two names

explanation.surface: The comic actor Peter Sellers bites his tongue.
explanation.definitionFit: Erse is an old name for the Gaelic language of Scotland or Ireland, and a tongue is a language.

clue.text: Romantic one understanding point in it

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a deal is an understanding or agreement

indicators.note: in says the compass point letter goes inside the word it

parts.note: S, for south, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: A romantic who reaches an understanding and sees the point of it all.
explanation.definitionFit: A romantic holds lofty, unrealistic hopes, the mark of a visionary dreamer.

clue.text: Flat accommodation for one letter

parts.note: reads like a single-occupancy flat to rent, but it is the paper sleeve a posted letter lies flat inside

explanation.surface: An advert for a flat suitable for a single tenant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flat' looks like housing and 'letter' like someone who lets property; really it is stationery holding a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: An envelope is a flat paper wrapper that holds a single piece of mail.

clue.text: Disgust aunt with ease when dancing

indicators.note: dancing letters move about, so aunt and ease are rearranged together

explanation.surface: An aunt disgusted by how easily someone takes to the dance floor.
explanation.definitionFit: To nauseate is to sicken or revolt, which is what disgust means as a verb.

clue.text: One entertaining does partner in performance

indicators.note: entertaining means holding as a guest, so the word one goes round the deer

parts.note: taken as the word one
a doe's mate is a stag

explanation.surface: Someone hosting a deer's mate as part of a show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'does' looks like a verb but is the plural of doe, female deer.
explanation.definitionFit: Onstage describes what happens in front of the audience, during the performance itself.

clue.text: Director and rising female to cuddle as couple

indicators.note: to cuddle means to hug, so the reversed female wraps round the rest
in a down answer rising means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a doe is a female deer or rabbit
a couple is two

explanation.surface: A director with a woman climbing up to cuddle as a pair.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down answer 'rising' reads the female deer upwards as EOD; 'to cuddle' then wraps it round the rest, entering just after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Clint Eastwood is a well-known American film director as well as an actor.

clue.text: Good deal needed for this call at whist

definitions.meaning: a good deal means plenty, a large amount
in solo whist this bid promises to win nine tricks

explanation.surface: A card player needs a good hand to make this bold whist bid.
explanation.walkthrough: The middle words tie the two meanings together: a plentiful hand is what this bid demands.
explanation.definitionFit: Abundance means a great quantity, and in solo whist it is a bid to take at least nine tricks.

clue.text: President — or where one is shot

indicators.note: shot means ruined or broken, so the letters of where one is are rearranged

explanation.surface: A question about which president, or where someone was gunned down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shot' suggests an assassination, but it means wrecked, signalling a rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Dwight D. Eisenhower was the 34th President of the United States.

clue.text: Authors get users to revise reference work

indicators.note: revising alters and reorders text, so these three words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Writers persuade their readers to update a standard reference book.
explanation.definitionFit: Roget's Thesaurus is a famous book of synonyms consulted by writers, a classic reference book.

clue.text: Presumably favouring genuine short hymn

indicators.note: short means cut, so the last letter is lopped off

parts.note: someone opposed to the fake would be anti-phony, so presumably in favour of the genuine

explanation.surface: Someone who seemingly prefers authenticity to a cut-down hymn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Presumably' admits the leap: against phony is taken to mean for genuine.
explanation.definitionFit: An antiphon is a short chant or hymn sung in alternating parts by two choirs.

clue.text: Removed duo found in grass

indicators.note: found in says the word for duo sits inside the word for grass

parts.note: a reed is a tall grass of wet places
a duo is a pair

explanation.surface: A couple who have gone missing are discovered hiding in long grass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Removed' is meant as went off somewhere, as in 'they repaired to the bar'.
explanation.definitionFit: To repair to a place is a formal way of saying went or removed oneself there.

clue.text: Patsy succeeded with attack on head

indicators.note: in an across answer 'on' puts the attack after the head

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for succeeded, as in family trees
a head is a headland, or cape
to go at someone is to attack them

explanation.surface: A fall guy succeeds after being hit on the head.
explanation.definitionFit: A patsy is a person made to take the blame for others, which is what a fall guy is.

clue.text: Literary lion takes time on slope

parts.note: Aslan is the lion in C. S. Lewis's Narnia books

explanation.surface: A lion from a book takes its time climbing a hillside.
explanation.definitionFit: Aslant means at an angle or slanting, so lying on a slope.

clue.text: One leaving whole sheep's heart in dish

indicators.note: leaving means departing, so the numeral is taken out of the word for whole

parts.note: entire means whole
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: the heart of the animal's name is its central letter, so only the middle one is taken

explanation.surface: A dish with an entire sheep's heart in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaving' drops I from ENTIRE to give ENTRE.
explanation.definitionFit: An entree is a dish served at a meal, a main course in the US or a course before it in Britain.

clue.text: Passing comment causes depression in each pub

indicators.note: in tells us the hollow goes inside the abbreviation for each

parts.note: a pit is a hollow or depression
PH, public house, is a map abbreviation for a pub

explanation.surface: An offhand remark that leaves each pub-goer feeling low.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Passing' means dying, not casual: the comment is written on a grave.
explanation.definitionFit: An epitaph is an inscription on a tomb, words said about someone who has died.

clue.text: Old suite composed in isolation

indicators.note: composed means put together or arranged, so the letters of old suite are rearranged

explanation.surface: An old musical suite written while the composer was cut off from the world.
explanation.walkthrough: 'composed' suggests music writing with 'suite', but it signals rearranging.
explanation.definitionFit: Solitude is the state of being alone, the same as isolation.

clue.text: In Amritsar it's something worn

indicators.note: In says the answer is held inside the following words

explanation.surface: A remark about clothing in the Indian city of Amritsar.
explanation.definitionFit: A sari is the draped garment worn by many women in South Asia.

clue.text: Remove top to drain jug

indicators.note: in a down answer the top is the first letter, which is taken away

parts.note: a sewer is a drain

explanation.surface: An instruction to take the lid off so a jug can be emptied.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drain' looks like a verb but is the noun SEWER.
explanation.definitionFit: A ewer is a large pitcher with a wide spout, a kind of jug.

clue.text: Pull out having contest no side wins

parts.note: with means having, as in a man with a hat
a game where neither side wins is a draw

explanation.surface: A side pulls out of a competition that nobody could win.
explanation.definitionFit: To withdraw is to retreat or remove oneself, which pulling out also means.

clue.text: Unsettled when flying

definitions.meaning: a matter not yet decided is said to be up ...
something airborne is literally up above the ground

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means undecided as well as literally being airborne, aloft above the ground.

clue.text: Minimum promotion among Northern Irish

indicators.note: among says the advert goes inside the two abbreviations

parts.note: an ad is a promotion or advert

explanation.surface: The smallest advertising campaign in Northern Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: The nadir is the lowest point of anything, its minimum.
